summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary repurchase of 255,414 ordinary shares from JP Morgan Securities plc on 6 May 2026 at an average price of £11.6057 per share (range £11.23–£11.77). The shares were bought on-exchange under existing shareholder authority and will be cancelled. This is a routine capital-return activity within an ongoing buyback programme, not a tender offer, issuer tender, or other special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors beyond the standing arrangement. No further analysis warranted.
